Equipment Proficiencies determine which weapons and tools a character can use effectively without penalty.

DMs: Confirm each character's equipment proficiencies at creation to avoid penalties on attack rolls or checks later.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Ray of Enfeeblement requires at least 1 point of spellburn to cast, catching many wizards off guard.

Judges: Make them burn at least 1 point of spellburn and target the muscle-bound brute, not the cannon fodder.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Hat Of The Hound's transformation lasts only 10 rounds daily.

GMs: Hold the Hat Of The Hound's 10-round transformation for when a mastiff's speed or scent can turn the tide.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Frame a Young Bronze Dragon encounter with a timer so the party must trade certainty for speed.

DMs: Remind players that the Young Bronze Dragon's Lightning Breath recharges on a 5-6; spread out to avoid a 60-foot line of 10d10 damage.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Hellthorn's tendril attack combines 1d6 damage with a grapple and poison sap that drains 1d4 Stamina.

Judges: Plant the Hellthorn in a narrow corridor; its 0' movement and tendrils will punish any fool who tries to rush past.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Turn Undead functions as a spell but doesn't count toward known spells.

GMs: Enforce Turn Undead's roll for highest undead level affected; it's not a limited spell, so use it freely.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

The Crossbow Bolt Case holds exactly 20 bolts, but players often forget its weight of 1 pound when calculating.

DMs: Remind players to count the Crossbow Bolt Case's 1-pound weight in their inventory to avoid encumbrance penalties.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

An untrained Skill Check only rolls 1d10, not 1d20, catching players off guard with lower success rates.

Judges: Remind players that untrained skill checks roll 1d10, not 1d20, to curb their overconfidence.

Giant Bat's near flying movement allows it to reposition and strike before most parties can react.

GMs: Exploit the Giant Bat's near flying movement to target the party's rear, punishing any gaps in their formation.

Ability Checks resolve with a single roll and a single ruling, avoiding prolonged debates.

DMs: Resolve each ability check with one d20 roll and decision to prevent gameplay from bogging down in endless debates.
